LanguageData.RT_T34_Vehicle.label: T-34 Obr.1940
LanguageData.RT_T34_Vehicle.description:
A medium tank with sloped armor and good productivity, equipped with a 76mm gun, have various upgrades for different needs.

<color=#bb8f04>Crew:</color> Driver x1, Gunner x2，MG gunner x1
<color=#bb8f04>Fuel:</color> Chemfuel

<color=#b0e0e6>CE Ammo:</color> 
76.2x385mmR（Main Cannon）
7.62x54mmR（Hull MG/Coaxial MG）
